topics.definition: A CNN is a deep learning model designed to process image and grid-like data using convolution operations.
Applies filters to extract features such as edges, textures and shapes.
tips: Use multiple filters to capture different patterns.

topics.definition: Pooling reduces feature map size while preserving important information.
Filters (kernels) are small matrices that detect visual patterns.
Combines extracted features to make the final prediction.
tips: Usually appears near the end of a CNN.

topics.definition: CNNs classify images into predefined categories.
tips: Use sufficient labeled images for training.

topics.definition: Common CNN models include LeNet, AlexNet, VGG, ResNet and EfficientNet.
tips: Choose the architecture based on accuracy and resource limits.

topics.definition: Normalize images, augment data and monitor validation performance.
